title: Izincwadi, imilayezo nezindaba
description: Ten short stories about letters, messages and media: an aunt's letter from cold Bulwer with apple jam, a shy text message and a booked table, a crime reporter's weekly report, a letter to a television animal programme, a sister's letter about their father's fall in the bath, a radio contest for church songs, a pen friend in Berlin, a radio phone-in about a burning rubbish heap, a holiday diary on a farm near Nongoma, and a television cooking show.

lessons.title: Incwadi kababekazi
lessons.summary: Thembelani in Johannesburg gets a letter from his paternal aunt Nonsikelelo in cold Bulwer: she feels cold every day, knits a jersey of grey wool on her old mat by the fire, sends him two bottles of apple jam, asks him to greet his wife and his father-in-law Mdlalose for her, and tells him to dress warmly at Christmas; he phones his father-in-law with her greetings.
lessons.text:
UThembelani uneminyaka engamashumi amathathu nesithupha. Uhlala eGoli nomfazi wakhe, futhi usebenza ehhovisi elikhulu. Ngolunye usuku lukaNtulikazi uthola incwadi evela kubabekazi wakhe, uNonsikelelo. Ubabekazi ngudadewabo kababa. UNonsikelelo uhlala eBulwer, idolobha elincane eliphezulu ezintabeni. Incwadi yakhe ithi:

"Thembelani wami othandekayo,

Ngiyakubingelela. Ngithemba ukuthi uphilile, wena nomfazi wakho. Mina ngiphilile, kodwa ngiyagodola. Lapha eBulwer kumakhaza kakhulu kulezi zinsuku. Ekuseni utshani bumhlophe ngesithwathwa, futhi amafu angwevu ahlala phezu kwezintaba usuku lonke. Nsuku zonke ngiyagodola, noma ngigqoka izingubo eziningi.

Ngakho ngiluka ijezi elisha ngovolo. Uvolo wami ungwevu njengamafu, futhi uyafudumala kakhulu. Kusihlwa ngihlala phansi eduze komlilo, phezu kukamata wami omdala, ngiluke. Ubaba wakho wayehlala phezu kwalo mata ngesikhathi eyingane, ngakho ngiyamthanda kakhulu lo mata.

Ngikuthumelela futhi ujamu. Kulo nyaka isihlahla sami samahhabhula sinamahhabhula amaningi kakhulu. Ngakha amahhabhula, ngawapheka noshukela, ngenza ujamu. Ngagcwalisa amabhodlela ayisithupha ngojamu wamahhabhula. Ngikuthumelela amabhodlela amabili. Ujamu wamahhabhula umnandi esinkwa ekuseni.

Ngiyacela, ngikhonzele kumfazi wakho. Ngikhonzele futhi kumukhwe wakho, uMdlalose. Ngambona ngosuku lomshado wenu, futhi wayengumuntu onomusa. Mtshele ukuthi ubabekazi wakho uyambingelela.

Uma uza eBulwer ngoKhisimusi, wambathe izingubo ezifudumele. Ngiyazi ukuthi ngoKhisimusi kuyashisa eGoli, kodwa lapha ezintabeni kusihlwa kuba makhaza ngisho nangehlobo. Ngizokuphekela, futhi sizodla ujamu ndawonye.

Ngiyakuthanda,
Ubabekazi wakho, uNonsikelelo"

UThembelani ufunda incwadi kumfazi wakhe. Umfazi wakhe uyahleka, athi: "Ubabekazi wakho unomusa kakhulu. Ngiyabona ukuthi uyagodola, kodwa usacabanga ngathi."

Kusihlwa uThembelani ushayela umukhwe wakhe ucingo. Uthi: "Baba, ubabekazi wami uthi ngimkhonzele kuwe. Ukubhale encwadini yakhe." UMdlalose uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga. Nawe umkhonzele kuye uma umbhalela. Ngiyamkhumbula ngosuku lomshado."

Ngakusasa ekuseni uThembelani udla isinkwa nojamu wamahhabhula. Ucabanga ngobabekazi wakhe, ohlezi phezu kukamata wakhe eBulwer, eluka ijezi lovolo ongwevu.

Imibuzo:
UNonsikelelo ungubani kuThembelani?
Ungubabekazi wakhe. Ungudadewabo kababa kaThembelani.
Kunjani eBulwer kulezi zinsuku?
Kumakhaza kakhulu, futhi uNonsikelelo uyagodola nsuku zonke.
UNonsikelelo uluka ijezi ngani?
Uliluka ngovolo ongwevu njengamafu.
UNonsikelelo uthumelani kuThembelani?
Uthumela amabhodlela amabili kajamu wamahhabhula.
UNonsikelelo uthi uThembelani akhonzele kubani?
Uthi akhonzele kumfazi wakhe, futhi akhonzele kumukhwe wakhe, uMdlalose.
Kungani uThembelani kufanele ambathe izingubo ezifudumele eBulwer?
Ngoba ezintabeni kusihlwa kuba makhaza ngisho nangehlobo.

lessons.title: Umqhafazo kaNkosenhle
lessons.summary: In Durban, shy Nkosenhle writes a text message asking Noluthando to dinner but hesitates for a long time, lest she say no; she answers within seconds, he books a table at a restaurant that is open on Saturday evening, counts the little money he has left, and at the end of the meal the waiter brings them sweets.
lessons.text:
UNkosenhle uneminyaka engamashumi amabili nesithupha. Usebenza esitolo esikhulu eThekwini. Eduze nesitolo kukhona ihhovisi, futhi kulelo hhovisi kusebenza intombazane ebizwa ngokuthi uNoluthando. UNkosenhle noNoluthando babonana nsuku zonke emini, futhi bayabingelelana. UNkosenhle uyamthanda uNoluthando, kodwa akambuzanga ukuthi angaphuma naye yini.

NgoLwesine kusihlwa uNkosenhle uhlezi endlini yakhe, ephethe iselula yakhe. Ufuna ukubhalela uNoluthando umqhafazo. Ubhala: "Sawubona Noluthando. Ngicela ukukumema ekudleni ngoMgqibelo kusihlwa." Ekugcineni komusho ubeka ungqi. Kodwa akawuthumeli umqhafazo. Uyanqikaza. Ucabanga: "Hleze athi cha. Hleze angihleke."

UNkosenhle unqikaza isikhathi eside. Usula umqhafazo wonke, abhale omunye omfushane: "Sawubona. Ungathanda ukudla nami ngoMgqibelo?" Ukhipha ungqi, ngoba manje lo musho uyabuza. Ubuka umqhafazo wakhe. Uyanqikaza futhi. Ucabanga: "Hleze akwazi ukuthi ngiyamthanda, angangifuni." Kodwa ekugcineni uthi: "Uma ngingabuzi, angeke ngazi." Uthumela umqhafazo.

Ngemuva kwamasekhondi angamashumi amathathu iselula iyakhala. Ngumqhafazo kaNoluthando. Uthi: "Yebo, ngingathanda kakhulu!" UNkosenhle akakholwa. Ucabanga: "Kade nginqikaza ihora lonke, kodwa yena ungiphendule ngemuva kwamasekhondi ambalwa nje!"

Manje kumele abhukhe itafula. UNkosenhle ushayela ucingo endaweni yokudlela eduze nolwandle. Ubuza: "Ingabe indawo yenu iyavulekile ngoMgqibelo kusihlwa?" Owesifazane uthi: "Yebo, indawo yethu iyavulekile kuze kube yihora leshumi ebusuku. Siyindawo evulekileyo nsuku zonke." UNkosenhle ubhukha itafula labantu ababili ngehora lesikhombisa. Owesifazane uthi: "Kulungile, sikubhukhele itafula."

Kodwa uNkosenhle unemadlana nje. Imali yakhe yomsebenzi izofika ngasekupheleni kwenyanga. Ubala imali esesikhwameni sakhe. Yimadlana, kodwa uthi: "Le madlana izokwanela ukudla okungabizi kakhulu."

NgoMgqibelo uNkosenhle noNoluthando bahlala etafuleni elibhukhiwe. Uweta uyafika, abanike iphepha lokudla. Uweta uyahleka kancane, abuze: "Nifunani namuhla?" UNkosenhle uthi kuweta: "Siyacela inhlanzi nelayisi." Uweta uyahamba, abuye nokudla okushisayo. UNkosenhle noNoluthando bayadla, baxoxe, bahleke.

Ekugcineni uweta ubeka uswidi etafuleni. Uthi: "Lo swidi ungowenu, mahhala." UNoluthando uthatha uswidi, athi: "Ngiyabonga. Namuhla bengijabule kakhulu." Manje uNkosenhle akasanqikazi. Uthi: "Nami. Singaphinde siphume ngelinye isonto?" UNoluthando uyahleka, athi: "Yebo. Kodwa ngelinye isonto ngizokubhalela mina umqhafazo."

Imibuzo:
UNkosenhle ufuna ukwenzani?
Ufuna ukubhalela uNoluthando umqhafazo, ammeme ekudleni ngoMgqibelo.
Kungani uNkosenhle enqikaza?
Ucabanga ukuthi hleze uNoluthando athi cha, noma amhleke.
UNoluthando uphendula ngemuva kwamasekhondi amangaki?
Uphendula ngemuva kwamasekhondi angamashumi amathathu.
Indawo yokudlela iyavulekile ngoMgqibelo kusihlwa na?
Yebo, iyavulekile kuze kube yihora leshumi ebusuku.
UNkosenhle ubhukha itafula labantu abangaki?
Ubhukha itafula labantu ababili ngehora lesikhombisa.
Uweta ubekani etafuleni ekugcineni?
Ubeka uswidi etafuleni, mahhala.

lessons.title: Umbiko kaNomathamsanqa
lessons.summary: Pinetown crime reporter Nomathamsanqa writes her Friday report: a pickpocket robbed old Gogo Magwaza at a bus stop, two cowardly thugs pushed her down and scratched her arm while people panicked, and a young stranger caught the pickpocket, who had also robbed drunkards; in a second short report a judge sends a rapist to jail, and her editor calls the young man the rescuer of Pinetown.
lessons.text:
UNomathamsanqa Mabhida ungumbhali wezindaba ephepheni lezindaba lasePinetown. NgoLwesihlanu ngamunye ubhala umbiko wezindaba zamacala zaleso sonto. Kuleli sonto unezindaba ezimbili.

Indaba yokuqala yenzeka ngoLwesibili ekuseni, endaweni lapho abantu belinda khona amabhasi. UGogo Magwaza, oneminyaka engamashumi ayisikhombisa, wayelinde ibhasi. Iqola lafika ngemuva kwakhe, lafaka isandla esikhwameni sakhe, lathatha imali yakhe. Lapho uGogo ebona iqola, wakhala kakhulu.

Ngaleso sikhathi kwafika amaphara amabili. Lawa maphara ayengabangane beqola. Amaphara asunduza uGogo kakhulu, wawa phansi. Elinye iphara lamklwebha engalweni ngezinzipho zalo, kwaphuma igazi. Abantu abaningi babetatazela. Abanye babaleka, abanye bakhala, kodwa akekho owasiza uGogo.

Kodwa eduze kwakukhona umufo omncane. Lo mufo akatatazelanga. Wagijima walijaha iqola, walibamba ngemuva kwemizuzu embalwa. Lapho amaphara ebona lokhu, abaleka. UNomathamsanqa ubhala embikweni wakhe: "Amaphara ayengamagwala. Asunduza ugogo omdala, amklwebha, kodwa lapho umufo efika, abaleka njengamagwala."

Umufo walibamba iqola kuze kwafika amaphoyisa. Amaphoyisa athi leli qola lantshontsha izikhwama eziningi ezinyangeni ezedlule. Lalithanda ukweba eziphuzini ezilala emgwaqweni ebusuku. Isiphuzi asazi lutho uma silele, ngakho asazi ukuthi imali yaso ithathiwe. Amaphoyisa athi amaphara nawo azofunwa.

UGogo Magwaza wayithola imali yakhe. Uthi ngomufo: "Lo mufo ungumhlengi wami. Ngiyambonga kakhulu." Amaphoyisa nawo athi umufo ungumhlengi, futhi abantu basePinetown kufanele bafunde kuye.

Indaba yesibili imfushane. NgoLwesithathu ijaji lathumela umdlwenguli ejele iminyaka engamashumi amabili. Lo mdlwenguli wahlasela abesifazane ababili ngonyaka odlule. Amaphoyisa amfuna izinyanga eziningi, ekugcineni ambamba. Abesifazane bathi bayajabula, ngoba umdlwenguli akasekho emgwaqweni.

UNomathamsanqa unika umhleli umbiko wakhe. Umhleli uwufunda, athi: "Lo mbiko muhle. Kodwa ngitshele, lo mufo ungubani?" UNomathamsanqa uthi: "Akafuni ukuthi igama lakhe libhalwe ephepheni. Uthi wenze nje lokho okufanele umuntu wonke akwenze." Umhleli uyahleka, athi: "Kulungile. Sizombiza ngokuthi umhlengi wasePinetown."

Imibuzo:
UNomathamsanqa ubhalani ngoLwesihlanu ngamunye?
Ubhala umbiko wezindaba zamacala zaleso sonto.
Iqola lenzani kuGogo Magwaza?
Lafaka isandla esikhwameni sakhe, lathatha imali yakhe.
Amaphara enzani?
Asunduza uGogo, wawa phansi, futhi elinye iphara lamklwebha engalweni.
Kungani uNomathamsanqa ethi amaphara ayengamagwala?
Ngoba asunduza ugogo omdala, kodwa lapho umufo efika, abaleka.
Iqola lalithanda ukweba kubani?
Lalithanda ukweba eziphuzini ezilala emgwaqweni ebusuku.
Ijaji lathumela umdlwenguli ejele iminyaka emingaki?
Lamthumela ejele iminyaka engamashumi amabili.

lessons.title: Uhlelo lwezilwane
lessons.summary: Ten-year-old Khethukuthula watches an animal programme on television with his grandfather Mtolo: springbok jumping in the Kalahari desert, a giraffe, a white rhino on young green grass, a scorpion and its venom, and rock hyraxes beside a waterfall where birds fly; he writes a letter to the programme, and a week later the presenter reads it out.
lessons.text:
UKhethukuthula uneminyaka eyishumi. Uhlala nomkhulu wakhe, uMtolo, eNongoma. NgoLwesithathu ngamunye kusihlwa bobabili babuka uhlelo lwezilwane kumabonakude. UKhethukuthula uthanda izilwane kakhulu, futhi umkhulu wakhe uyazazi izilwane eziningi.

Namuhla uhlelo luqala ogwadule lweKalahari. Owesifazane okhuluma kuhlelo uthi: "Ugwadule yindawo eyomile kakhulu. Ogwadule imvula ina kancane kakhulu, futhi kunesihlabathi esiningi." UKhethukuthula ubona izinsephe eziningi zihamba esihlabathini. Insephe yisilwane esincane esinombala onsundu nomhlophe. Izinsephe ziyagxuma kakhulu, ziphakeme emoyeni. UKhethukuthula uyahleka, athi: "Mkhulu, bheka! Izinsephe zigxuma njengebhola!"

Owesifazane uthi: "Ngemuva kwemvula, ugwadule luyashintsha. Kuvela uhlaza, futhi izinsephe zidla uhlaza olusha." UMkhulu uthi: "Nalapha eNongoma, ngemuva kwemvula, izinkomo zithanda uhlaza."

Bese uhlelo lukhombisa indlulamithi. Indlulamithi inentamo ende kakhulu, futhi idla amahlamvu aphezulu ezihlahleni. UKhethukuthula uthi: "Indlulamithi inde kunendlu yethu!" UMkhulu uthi: "Yebo. Kodwa indlulamithi akulula ukuthi iphuze amanzi, ngoba kumele igobe intamo yayo ende."

Ngemuva kwalokho kuvela umkhombo. Umkhombo ngubhejane omkhulu ompunga, onezimpondo ezimbili. Umkhombo udla uhlaza phansi, ngoba unomlomo obanzi. UMkhulu uthi: "Abantu ababi babulala imikhombo ngenxa yezimpondo zayo. Ngakho kumele siyivikele."

Bese uhlelo lubuyela ogwadule. Phansi kwetshe kuhlala ufezela. Owesifazane uthi: "Ufezela unesihlungu emsileni wakhe. Uma ufezela ukuhlaba, isihlungu sakhe sibuhlungu kakhulu." UKhethukuthula uyesaba kancane. Uthi: "Mkhulu, kukhona ofezela eNongoma na?" UMkhulu uthi: "Yebo, bakhona. Ngakho ungafaki isandla sakho phansi kwamatshe."

Ekugcineni uhlelo lukhombisa impophoma enkulu. Amanzi empophoma ayawa phezu kwamatshe. Ematsheni aseduze nempophoma kuhlala izimbila. Imbila yisilwane esincane esinoboya obunsundu. Izimbila zihlala elangeni ekuseni, zifudumale. Phezu kwempophoma izinyoni ziyaphapha. Ziphapha phezulu, zibuye phansi emanzini.

Ngemuva kohlelo uKhethukuthula ubhalela abantu bohlelo incwadi. Ubhala: "Ngiyabonga ngohlelo lwenu. Ngithanda izinsephe nezimbila. Ngicela ukwazi: imbila iyaphuza amanzi empophoma na?" UMkhulu uthumela incwadi.

NgoLwesithathu olandelayo owesifazane wohlelo ufunda incwadi kaKhethukuthula kumabonakude. Uthi: "Khethukuthula, imbila ithola amanzi amaningi ekudleni kwayo, kodwa iyaphuza nasempophomeni." UKhethukuthula uyajabula kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
UKhethukuthula ubukani noMkhulu ngoLwesithathu?
Babuka uhlelo lwezilwane kumabonakude.
Ugwadule luyindawo enjani?
Yindawo eyomile kakhulu, enesihlabathi esiningi.
Izinsephe zidlani ngemuva kwemvula?
Zidla uhlaza olusha.
Kungani abantu ababi bebulala imikhombo?
Bayibulala ngenxa yezimpondo zayo.
Ufezela unesihlungu kuphi?
Unesihlungu emsileni wakhe.
Izinyoni zenzani phezu kwempophoma?
Ziyaphapha phezulu, zibuye phansi emanzini.

lessons.title: Incwadi kaNozizwe
lessons.summary: Nozizwe writes to her brother in London about their old father Ximba: he slipped in the bath and fell on the back of his head, the doctor's explanation is that his thigh bone broke but his spine is sound, after the operation the nurses waited for him to break wind, he now walks slowly with a stick, his beard has grown, and a leaflet in the waiting room tells men over fifty to have the anus and rectum checked.
lessons.text:
UNozizwe uneminyaka engamashumi amane. Uhlala eThekwini, futhi ubhuti wakhe omdala uhlala eLondon. NgoLwesihlanu kusihlwa uNozizwe ubhalela ubhuti wakhe incwadi ende ngobaba wabo, uXimba. Incwadi ithi:

"Bhuti wami,

Nginezindaba ezingezinhle ngobaba. NgoMsombuluko ekuseni ubaba wayegeza ebhavini. Lapho ephuma ebhavini, washelela phezu kwamanzi ayephansi. Wawa phansi kakhulu, washaya isiphundu sakhe odongeni. Ngamthola elele phansi eduze kukabhavu. Wayengakwazi ukuvuka. Ngashayela ucingo, kwafika imoto yesibhedlela.

Esibhedlela udokotela wamhlola isikhathi eside. Ngemuva kwalokho udokotela wasinika incazo ende. Incazo yakhe ithi: inyonga yesobunxele kababa iphukile. Inyonga yithambo elikhulu lomlenze, futhi kumele ihlinzwe. Kodwa isiphundu sakhe siphilile, futhi umqolo wakhe uqatha. Udokotela wathi: 'Umqolo kababa wenu uqatha njengowensizwa.' Ngajabula ukuzwa leyo ncazo.

NgoLwesibili udokotela wahlinza inyonga kababa. Ngemuva kokuhlinzwa abahlengikazi bamlinda ukuthi asuze. Owesifazane othile wathi: 'Uma esuzile, sizokwazi ukuthi umzimba wakhe usebenza kahle.' Ubaba wamangala, wathi: 'Ngineminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili, kodwa namanje akekho ongicele ukuthi ngisuze!' Kusihlwa wasuza, futhi odokotela bajabula. Nathi sahleka kakhulu.

Manje ubaba uyashukuma. NgoLwesithathu washukumisa izinzwane zakhe, bese eshukuma embhedeni. Namuhla useyahamba, kodwa ucathula kancane ngenduku. Ucathula esuka embhedeni, aye emnyango, abuyele embhedeni. Uthi: 'Ngicathula njengengane encane.'

Ubaba akagundile isilevu sakhe kusukela ngoMsombuluko. Manje isilevu sakhe side futhi simhlophe. Uthi akafuni ukusigunda, ngoba isilevu simenza abukeke njengomkhulu wakhe.

Bhuti, kukhona okunye. Ngesikhathi ngilinde ubaba esibhedlela, ngafunda iphepha elikhuluma ngezifo zengquza. Iphepha lithi amadoda amadala kuneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu kufanele ahlolwe ingquza njalo. Izifo zengquza ziyelashwa uma zitholakala ngokushesha. Wena uneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu nesithupha. Ngicela uhlolwe ingquza eLondon.

Ubaba uyakubingelela. Uthi uze ekhaya ngoZibandlela.

Ngiyakuthanda,
uNozizwe"

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani kuXimba ngoMsombuluko ekuseni?
Washelela lapho ephuma ebhavini, wawa phansi, washaya isiphundu sakhe odongeni.
Incazo kadokotela ithini?
Ithi inyonga kaXimba iphukile, kodwa isiphundu sakhe siphilile futhi umqolo wakhe uqatha.
Kungani abahlengikazi befuna ukuthi uXimba asuze?
Ngoba uma esuzile, bazokwazi ukuthi umzimba wakhe usebenza kahle.
UXimba uhamba kanjani namuhla?
Ucathula kancane ngenduku.
Kungani uXimba engafuni ukugunda isilevu sakhe?
Ngoba isilevu simenza abukeke njengomkhulu wakhe.
Iphepha lesibhedlela lithi amadoda kufanele enzeni?
Lithi amadoda amadala kuneminyaka engamashumi amahlanu kufanele ahlolwe ingquza njalo.

lessons.title: Umncintiswano womsakazo
lessons.summary: In Umlazi, guitarist Nqabayethu, nicknamed Quick Fingers, and his sister Nomalizo, who plays the piano, enter a radio contest for church songs; he is lazy about practising until their mother scolds him, nobody in the house sleeps much the night before the final, listeners vote by text message and the two are named the winners, and the pastor tells their proud mother that there is no sin in being proud of good work.
lessons.text:
UNqabayethu Zikalala uneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye, kanti udadewabo, uNomalizo, uneminyaka eyishumi nesikhombisa. Bahlala eMlazi nomama wabo. UNqabayethu ushaya isigingci, futhi uNomalizo ushaya ipiyano. NgeSonto ngalinye bacula ebandleni labo. UNqabayethu ushaya isigingci, uNomalizo ushaya ipiyano, futhi abantu bebandla bacula nabo.

Abantu bebandla banika uNqabayethu isiga. Bambiza ngokuthi "Minwe Esheshayo", ngoba iminwe yakhe ihamba ngokushesha kakhulu esigingcini. UNomalizo naye unesiga. Bambiza ngokuthi "Nyoni Encane", ngoba ucula kamnandi njengenyoni. UNomalizo uyasithanda isiga sakhe, kodwa uNqabayethu uthi isiga sakhe siyamhlekisa.

NgoNhlangulana uNomalizo uzwa emsakazweni ukuthi kukhona umncintiswano wezingoma zokholo. Amaqembu amancane kufanele athumele ingoma yawo. Amaqembu amathathu angcono azocula emsakazweni ngoMgqibelo wokugcina kaNhlangulana, futhi abalaleli bazokhetha umnqobi ngomqhafazo. Umnqobi uzothola imali eningi.

UNomalizo uthi: "Masingene!" UNqabayethu uthi: "Kulungile." Kodwa uNqabayethu uyavilapha. Ekuseni ulala kuze kube yihora leshumi. Emini ubuka umabonakude. Akasishayi isigingci sakhe. UNomalizo yena ushaya ipiyano nsuku zonke, kusukela ekuseni kuze kube kusihlwa.

Ngolunye usuku umama uthi kuNqabayethu: "Ndodana yami, ungavilaphi! UNomalizo usebenza kanzima epiyanweni, kodwa wena uyavilapha. Umnqobi akavilaphi." UNqabayethu uyaphoxeka. Kusukela ngalolo suku uyavuka ekuseni, ashaye isigingci isikhathi eside nsuku zonke.

Iqembu labo liyakhethwa, futhi bazocula emsakazweni. Ngobusuku obungaphambi komncintiswano kwalalwa kancane kakhulu endlini yakwaZikalala. UNomalizo wayecabanga ngengoma. UNqabayethu wayeshaya isigingci kancane endlini yakhe. Umama wayethandaza. Ekuseni umama uthi: "Izolo ebusuku akulalwanga lapha endlini!" Bonke bayahleka.

NgoMgqibelo bacula emsakazweni. UNqabayethu ushaya isigingci, uNomalizo ushaya ipiyano, futhi bacula ndawonye. Abalaleli abaningi bathumela imiqhafazo. Kusihlwa umuntu ohola uhlelo uthi: "Abanqobi bomncintiswano yiqembu likaNqabayethu noNomalizo Zikalala!"

Umama ugcwele ukuzigqaja. Uthi kubantu bebandla: "Izingane zami zingabanqobi!" Kodwa ngeSonto ubuza umfundisi: "Mfundisi, ukuzigqaja kuyisono na?" Umfundisi uthi: "Cha, akukho sono ekuzigqajeni ngomsebenzi omuhle wezingane zakho. Kodwa ungakhohlwa ukubonga uNkulunkulu." Umama uyahleka, athi: "Uma kungekho sono, ngizoqhubeka nokuzigqaja ngazo!"

Imibuzo:
Siyini isiga sikaNqabayethu?
Abantu bebandla bambiza ngokuthi Minwe Esheshayo.
Kungani uNomalizo enesiga esithi Nyoni Encane?
Ngoba ucula kamnandi njengenyoni.
Kungani umama ethi uNqabayethu angavilaphi?
Ngoba uNomalizo usebenza kanzima epiyanweni, kodwa uNqabayethu uyavilapha.
Kwalalwa kanjani endlini yakwaZikalala ngobusuku obungaphambi komncintiswano?
Kwalalwa kancane kakhulu.
Ngubani umnqobi womncintiswano?
Umnqobi yiqembu likaNqabayethu noNomalizo Zikalala.
Umfundisi uthini ngokuzigqaja?
Uthi akukho sono ekuzigqajeni ngomsebenzi omuhle wezingane.

lessons.title: Umngane waseBerlin
lessons.summary: Fourteen-year-old Mthokozi of KwaMakhutha writes to his pen friend Lukas in Berlin: Lukas teaches him German words and learns Hebrew from his grandmother, Mthokozi's teacher Mavimbela explains the Nguni languages with an example, they compare their height in centimetres and in his grandfather's inches, Lukas sends a rectangular photo of a yellow bus, and Mthokozi admits he was a fool to think Berlin is always snowy.
lessons.text:
UMthokozi uneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha. Ufunda esikoleni eKwaMakhutha. NgoNdasa umfundisi wakhe wesiNgisi, uMavimbela, uthi kubafundi: "Ngamunye wenu uzothola umngane esikoleni saseBerlin. Nizobhalelana izincwadi ngesiNgisi." UMthokozi uthola umngane obizwa ngokuthi uLukas. ULukas naye uneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha.

UMthokozi ubhala incwadi yokuqala. Ubhala ngomndeni wakhe, ngesikole nangebhola. Ekugcineni ubhala: "Ngiyazi ukuthi eBerlin kumakhaza njalo, futhi kukhona iqhwa unyaka wonke."

Ngemuva kwamasonto amathathu uMthokozi uthola impendulo kaLukas. ULukas ubhala ngesiNgisi, kodwa ufaka namagama ambalwa esiJalimani. Ubhala: "Ngizokufundisa amagama esiJalimani, futhi wena uzongifundisa isiZulu." Ubhala futhi ukuthi ugogo wakhe wazalelwa ezweni elikude, futhi ukhuluma isiHebheru. Ngakho uLukas ufunda isiHebheru kugogo wakhe ngoMgqibelo. Uthi: "IsiHebheru sibhalwa kusukela kwesokudla kuya kwesokunxele. Kunzima kakhulu!"

ULukas ubuza: "IsiZulu siyafana nezinye izilimi na?" UMthokozi akazi. Ngakusasa ubuza uMavimbela. UMavimbela uthi: "IsiZulu singesinye sezilimi zesiNguni. IsiZulu, isiXhosa nesiNdebele zonke zingezesiNguni. Ngakho abantu abakhuluma isiZulu bayasizwa isiXhosa kancane." UMthokozi uthi: "Ngicela umzekelo." UMavimbela uthi: "Ngizokunika umzekelo: ngesiZulu sithi umuntu, ngesiXhosa bathi umntu. Ngizokunika omunye umzekelo: ngesiZulu sithi amanzi, nangesiXhosa bathi amanzi." UMthokozi ubhalela uLukas yonke le mizekelo.

Encwadini yakhe yesibili uLukas ubuza: "Umude ngamasentimitha amangaki? Mina ngingamasentimitha ayikhulu namashumi ayisithupha nesihlanu." UMthokozi akawazi amasentimitha akhe. Ubuza umkhulu wakhe. Umkhulu wakhe akasebenzisi amasentimitha. Usebenzisa amayintshi, njengoba kwakwenziwa kudala. Umkhulu uthatha intambo ende, alinganise uMthokozi ngamayintshi. Uthi: "Umude ngamayintshi angamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha." UMthokozi ubala ngekhompyutha: amayintshi angamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha angamasentimitha ayikhulu namashumi ayisithupha nesishiyagalombili. Ngakho uMthokozi mude kancane kunoLukas.

Encwadini yesithathu uLukas uthumela isithombe esincane. Isithombe singunxande, futhi sinomugqa ompunga emaceleni. Esithombeni kukhona ibhasi eliphuzi elihamba emgwaqweni waseBerlin elangeni lehlobo. ULukas ubhala: "Bheka, eBerlin kuyashisa ehlobo! Iqhwa likhona ebusika kuphela."

UMthokozi ubuka isithombe esingunxande, ibhasi eliphuzi nelanga. Uyahleka, athi kumkhulu wakhe: "Ngangiyisithutha! Ngangicabanga ukuthi eBerlin kuhlala kukhona iqhwa." Umkhulu uthi: "Awusona isithutha, mzukulu. Umuntu ongazi, uyafunda." UMthokozi ubhalela uLukas: "Ngangiyisithutha, kodwa manje ngiyazi. Ngiyabonga, mngane wami."

Imibuzo:
ULukas ufaka magama mani encwadini yakhe?
Ufaka amagama ambalwa esiJalimani.
ULukas ufunda isiHebheru kubani?
Usifunda kugogo wakhe ngoMgqibelo.
UMavimbela unika uMthokozi muphi umzekelo?
Uthi ngesiZulu sithi umuntu, ngesiXhosa bathi umntu.
ULukas mude ngamasentimitha amangaki?
Mude ngamasentimitha ayikhulu namashumi ayisithupha nesihlanu.
Kungani umkhulu kaMthokozi esebenzisa amayintshi?
Ngoba wayesebenzisa amayintshi kusukela kudala, akasebenzisi amasentimitha.
Kungani uMthokozi ethi wayeyisithutha?
Ngoba wayecabanga ukuthi eBerlin kuhlala kukhona iqhwa, kodwa ehlobo kuyashisa.

lessons.title: Ibibi lasePinetown
lessons.summary: On Cebekhulu's morning phone-in programme, caller Thandekile complains about a rubbish heap near her house: people burn it, smoke rises from it, it smells of sulphur, and old beds full of bedbugs are thrown on it; most callers agree that burning rubbish near homes is madness, and Nzimande of the congress comes on the line and promises a lorry to move the heap away, which he does that Friday.
lessons.text:
UCebekhulu unohlelo emsakazweni wasePinetown. NgoMsombuluko ngamunye ekuseni abalaleli bashayela ucingo ohlelweni lwakhe, bakhulume ngezinkinga zendawo yabo. UCebekhulu uthi: "Ngiyanibingelela, Pinetown! Izingcingo zethu zivulekile. Ninezinkinga zini namuhla?"

Owokuqala ukushayela nguThandekile. Uthi: "Ngiyakubingelela, Cebekhulu. Nginenkinga enkulu. Eduze nendlu yami kukhona ibibi elikhulu kakhulu. Abantu baphonsa udoti wabo kuleli bibi nsuku zonke: amaphepha, amabhodlela nokudla okubolile."

UCebekhulu uyabuza: "Ibibi liseduze nendlu yakho na?" UThandekile uthi: "Liseduze kakhulu. Futhi abanye abantu bayalishisa ibibi ebusuku. Ekuseni ibibi lisashunqa. Intuthu iyashunqa iye phezulu, bese ingena ezindlini zethu. Izingane zami ziyakhwehlela."

UThandekile uqhubeka: "Kukhona okunye. Lapho ibibi lishunqa, linuka njengesibabule. Isibabule sinuka kabi kakhulu, njengamaqanda abolile. Uma umoya ushaya ngasendlini yami, sinukelwa yisibabule ubusuku bonke."

UCebekhulu uthi: "Lokho kubi kakhulu. Kukhona okunye na?" UThandekile uthi: "Yebo. Abantu baphonsa nemibhede emidala ebibini. Le mibhede igcwele izimbungulu. Izimbungulu ziphuma emibhedeni, zingene ezindlini zethu. Ebusuku izimbungulu ziyasiluma embhedeni wethu."

UCebekhulu uthi: "Nina bantu basePinetown, nithini?" Abanye abalaleli bayashayela. Owesifazane uthi: "Ukushisa udoti eduze nezindlu kungubuhlanya. Kuphela isiphukuphuku esingashisa ibibi eduze nezingane." Indoda ithi: "Yebo, kungubuhlanya ngempela." Abanye abambalwa bathi abantu abanayo indawo yokubeka udoti wabo. Kodwa imvama yabantu ithi ibibi kufanele lithathwe. UCebekhulu uthi: "Imvama yenu ithi ibibi kufanele lithathwe. Ngubani ongasisiza?"

Ngemuva kwemizuzu embalwa kushayela uNzimande. UNzimande ungomunye wabantu abahola ukhongolose endaweni. UCebekhulu uthi: "Ngiyakubingelela, Baba Nzimande. Ukhongolose uzokwenzani ngaleli bibi?" UNzimande uthi: "Ngiyezwa ukuthi imvama yabantu ayilifuni ibibi. Ngizothumela iloli ngoLwesihlanu. Iloli lizoliqhelisa ibibi ezindlini zabantu, liyise endaweni yodoti ekude nedolobha."

UThandekile uthi: "Ngiyabonga, kodwa ngizokholwa uma ngibona iloli." ULwesihlanu luyafika, futhi iloli liyafika. Amadoda aqhelisa ibibi, alithwale ngeloli. Abantu baqhelisa nemibhede enezimbungulu, bayishise kude nezindlu.

NgoMsombuluko olandelayo uThandekile ushayela uCebekhulu futhi. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga, Cebekhulu. Ibibi alisekho. Akusekho ntuthu, futhi akusanuki isibabule. Ngibonga nokhongolose."

Imibuzo:
UThandekile unenkinga enjani?
Eduze nendlu yakhe kukhona ibibi elikhulu kakhulu.
Kwenzekani ekuseni ngemuva kokuthi abantu bashise ibibi ebusuku?
Ibibi lisashunqa, futhi intuthu ingena ezindlini.
Ibibi linuka njani?
Linuka njengesibabule, linuka kabi njengamaqanda abolile.
Kungani izimbungulu zingena ezindlini?
Ngoba abantu baphonsa imibhede emidala egcwele izimbungulu ebibini.
Owesifazane uthi kuphela bani ongashisa ibibi eduze nezingane?
Uthi kuphela isiphukuphuku esingashisa ibibi eduze nezingane.
Imvama yabantu ithini?
Imvama ithi ibibi kufanele lithathwe.
Iloli likaNzimande lenzani ngoLwesihlanu?
Liqhelisa ibibi ezindlini, liyise endaweni yodoti ekude nedolobha.

lessons.title: Izinsuku zami epulazini
lessons.summary: In her holiday diary, Bonokuhle writes about a week on her uncle Mpungose's farm near Nongoma: he lifts her onto his horse to explore the farm and shows her an old marula tree and the medicine in its bark, she follows a hunting party whose dogs bark at hares, learns to row with an oar, sees lightning strike the marula in a windy storm and break off a big branch, and watches sparks fly from the fire.
lessons.text:
NgoMsombuluko

Igama lami nguBonokuhle, futhi ngineminyaka eyishumi nesithupha. Namuhla ngifike epulazini likamalume wami, uMpungose, eduze kwaseNongoma. Ngizohlala lapha isonto lonke ngamaholide kaZibandlela. Umama wathi kufanele ngibhale nsuku zonke ngalokho engikubonayo, ngakho ngiyabhala.

Emini ngahlwaya ipulazi nomalume. Ipulazi likhulu kakhulu, futhi ngangifuna ukulazi lonke. Umalume wangikhweza ehhashini lakhe elimnyama, ngoba angikwazi ukugibela ihhashi ngedwa. Bese naye ekhwela, sahamba kancane. Sahlwaya izintaba ezincane, umfula nehlathi. Ngiyakuthanda ukuhlwaya izindawo ezintsha.

Ngasemfuleni kukhona umganu omkhulu. Umalume uthi lo mganu mdala kakhulu, mdala kunomkhulu wami. Izithelo zomganu zivuthwa ngoNhlolanja. Umalume wasika igxolo elincane lomganu ngommese. Igxolo lomganu linsundu futhi lilukhuni. Umalume uthi: "Ugogo wakho wayesebenzisa leli gxolo njengomuthi uma umuntu egula."

NgoLwesibili

Namuhla kwakukhona inqina. Inqina yiqembu lamadoda azingela ndawonye ngezinja nangezinduku. Amadoda ayishumi nezinja eziyisithupha bahamba ehlathini. Umalume wangivumela ukuthi ngihambe nabo, kodwa ngangihamba ngemuva.

Izinja zazikhonkotha kakhulu lapho zibona unogwaja. Unogwaja wagijima, izinja zamjaha zikhonkotha. Inqina yabuya nonogwaja ababili. Lapho sibuyela ekhaya, izinja zazisakhonkotha. Kusihlwa sadla inyama yonogwaja.

NgoLwesithathu

Umalume unesikebhe esincane emfuleni. Namuhla wanginika isigwedlo, wathi: "Gwedla!" Ngabamba isigwedlo ngezandla zombili. Ekuqaleni isikebhe sajika, sasingahambi phambili. Isigwedlo sasisinda kakhulu. Umalume wangifundisa ukufaka isigwedlo emanzini kancane. Ekugcineni ngagwedla kahle, isikebhe sahamba.

NgoLwesine

Kusihlwa umoya waqala ukuvunguza. Wavunguza kakhulu, izihlahla zanyakaza. Bese kwafika umbane. Umbane wakhanya esibhakabhakeni, futhi izulu laduma kakhulu. Umbane washaya umganu omdala ngasemfuleni. Ihlahla elikhulu lomganu laphuka, lawa phansi. Ngesaba kakhulu. Umalume wathi: "Ungahlali ngaphansi kwesihlahla uma kukhona umbane."

NgoLwesihlanu

Ekuseni umoya wawungasavunguzi. Sahamba saya emfuleni. Umganu awuwanga, kodwa ihlahla lawo elikhulu lilele phansi. Umalume wasika ihlahla izingxenye ezincane. Kusihlwa sabasa umlilo ngaphandle, futhi umalume wafaka izingxenye zehlahla emlilweni. Izinhlansi zaqhasha emlilweni, zaphaphela phezulu njengezinyoni ezincane. Umalume wathi: "Qaphela, izinhlansi ziyaqhasha. Hlala kude nomlilo!" Izinja zazilele, zingasakhonkothi.

NgoMgqibelo ngibuyela eThekwini. Ngizokhumbula umganu, inqina nesigwedlo.

Imibuzo:
Umalume wenzani ukuze uBonokuhle ahlwaye ipulazi?
Wamkhweza ehhashini lakhe elimnyama, bese naye ekhwela.
Igxolo lomganu linjani?
Linsundu futhi lilukhuni, futhi ugogo wayelisebenzisa njengomuthi.
Inqina yini?
Inqina yiqembu lamadoda azingela ndawonye ngezinja nangezinduku.
Izinja zenzani lapho zibona unogwaja?
Zikhonkotha kakhulu, zimjahe.
Kwenzekani emganwini ngoLwesine kusihlwa?
Umbane wawushaya, ihlahla lawo elikhulu laphuka, lawa phansi.
Izinhlansi zenzani emlilweni?
Zaqhasha emlilweni, zaphaphela phezulu njengezinyoni ezincane.

lessons.title: Pheka noNtombomzi
lessons.summary: On her Sunday television cooking show, Ntombomzi cooks beef with speckled sugar beans: her knife is blunt until her helper Thokozisi brings another, the chunks of meat shrink in the big pot, the broth grows thick with the beans, the cork of the oil bottle will not come out, she squeezes oranges and sprinkles water on the bread, and she answers a viewer's text message about the thick broth.
lessons.text:
UNtombomzi Makhanya unohlelo lokupheka kumabonakude. Uhlelo lwakhe lubizwa ngokuthi "Pheka noNtombomzi", futhi lubukwa ngeSonto kusihlwa. UNtombomzi upheka ekhishini elikhulu, futhi umfana osebenza naye, uThokozisi, umsiza ngakho konke. Ababukeli bathumela imiqhafazo ngesikhathi sohlelo, futhi uNtombomzi uyabaphendula.

Namuhla uNtombomzi upheka inyama yenkomo nobhontshisi. Uthi: "Ngiyanibingelela! Namuhla sizopheka ukudla okumnandi kakhulu kobusika. Sizosebenzisa ikhanzi elikhulu, ngoba sizopheka kakhulu." UThokozisi ubeka ikhanzi elikhulu elimnyama esitofini.

UNtombomzi uthatha inyama, aqale ukuyisika amaqatha. Kodwa ummese wakhe ngummese obuthuntu. Uyasika, uyasika, kodwa inyama ayisikeki kahle. Uyahleka, athi: "Bheka, lo mmese mubi, ngummese obuthuntu! Ummese obuthuntu awusiki inyama." UThokozisi umnika omunye ummese obukhali. Manje uNtombomzi usika inyama amaqatha amakhulu, ayishumi.

Ufaka amaqatha enyama ekhanzini, athele amanzi. Uthi: "Bukani amaqatha. Manje makhulu, kodwa uma inyama ivuthwa, iyashwabana. Ngemuva kwehora amaqatha azoba mancane." Ngemuva kwehora uvula ikhanzi. Ngempela amaqatha ashwabene. Amanzi ekhanzini manje angumhluzi omnandi wenyama.

Bese uNtombomzi uthatha ubhontshisi. Ubhontshisi wakhe ufekethile: unombala omhlophe nobomvu. Uthi: "Ubhontshisi ofekethile umnandi kakhulu emhluzini." Ufaka ubhontshisi ofekethile emhluzini, ekhanzini. Ngemuva kwesikhathi umhluzi uba gqinsi, ngoba ubhontshisi uwenza ube gqinsi.

UNtombomzi ufuna ukufaka amafutha amancane. Uthatha ibhodlela lamafutha, kodwa isivimbo salo asiphumi. Udonsa isivimbo, kodwa asiphumi. UThokozisi uthatha ibhodlela, adonse isivimbo kakhulu. Ekugcineni isivimbo siyaphuma. Bonke bayahleka.

Ngemuva kwalokho uNtombomzi uthatha otamatisi abathathu. Ukhama utamatisi ngamunye ngezandla zakhe phezu kwekhanzi, amanzi akhe angene emhluzini. Uthi: "Khama utamatisi kahle, uze uphele." Bese uchela amanzi amancane phezu kwesinkwa esidala, asifake kuhhavini. Uthi: "Uma uchela amanzi esinkwa esidala, siba sihle futhi."

Ngaleso sikhathi kufika umqhafazo womuntu obukele uhlelo. UThokozisi uyawufunda: "Ntombomzi, umhluzi wami awubi gqinsi. Ngenzeni?" UNtombomzi uthi: "Faka ubhontshisi omningi, futhi uwupheke isikhathi eside. Umhluzi uzoba gqinsi."

Ekugcineni uNtombomzi uthela inyama nomhluzi ogqinsi esitsheni. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga ngokubuka. Sizobonana ngeSonto elizayo!"

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani lapho uNtombomzi eqala ukusika inyama?
Ummese wakhe ngummese obuthuntu, futhi inyama ayisikeki kahle.
Amaqatha enyama enzani uma evuthwa ekhanzini?
Ayashwabana.
Ubhontshisi kaNtombomzi unjani?
Ufekethile: unombala omhlophe nobomvu.
Kungani umhluzi uba gqinsi?
Ngoba ubhontshisi uwenza ube gqinsi.
UThokozisi wenzani ngebhodlela lamafutha?
Udonsa isivimbo salo kakhulu, size siphume.
Umuntu obukele uhlelo uthini emqhafazweni wakhe?
Uthi umhluzi wakhe awubi gqinsi, futhi ubuza ukuthi enzeni.
